distinct-operations-need-tools-01.graded_text: Agents can search page content across the workspace in one call, through a dedicated search tool or a content query on a listing tool, with explicit scope and pagination, instead of reading pages one by one. The query uses familiar text-search semantics (plain text, phrase, or regular expression) rather than a bespoke query language.

votes.e: C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md:19-21: "`query`: required, nonempty. Case-insensitive. A page matches when it contains every word. Text in double quotes matches as an exact phrase." / "`folder`: optional. ... When omitted, searches the whole workspace." / "`cursor`, `limit`: same paging as `list_pages`. Default 20, maximum 50." Plain words plus quoted phrases is familiar text-search syntax, with explicit scope and paging.

distinct-operations-need-tools-02.graded_text: Placing a print order is its own tool, not a file write, a special path, or a flag on an existing tool, because it charges money and ships goods.

votes.e: C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md:11: "`order_prints` | `{ request_id, paths[], copies, ship_to }` | Orders printed, bound copies of the listed pages, charges the workspace's card on file, and ships one package. Editors only." This is a dedicated tool, and line 64 rejects a flag variant: "Do not add a dry-run flag to `order_prints`."

distinct-operations-need-tools-03.graded_text: A retried print-order call after a timeout cannot charge twice: the design states an idempotency key, a single-use quote or order ID, or an equivalent server-side guard.

votes.e: C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md:30: "`request_id`: required. ... Send the same `request_id` again to retry the same order. It never places a second order or charges twice." Line 42 adds the `already_placed` outcome, line 53 adds the `request_id_reused` refusal, and line 55 adds the `outcome_unknown` retry rule.

distinct-operations-need-tools-04.graded_text: The catalog adds no generic execute, run, or action tool.

votes.e: Checked C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md (7 rows, lines 5-11) and C/diff.txt. There is no execute, run or action tool. The closest line is C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md:64: "If agents need to show a price before ordering, add a read-only `quote_prints` tool", which is a specific deferred tool and not a generic one.

distinct-operations-need-tools-05.graded_text: The existing five file tools keep their names, and each behaves as before for calls that use only its current arguments.

votes.e: C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md:5,7-10 keep each original name, argument list and behavior text verbatim, e.g. "| `edit_page` | `{ path, old_string, new_string }` | Replaces one unique exact string in one page. | destructive |".
